title: Convex Hulls for R
text: package can installed along tests run executing make command geometria working directory. OpenMP required package compile work properly. Note: MacOS, OpenMP available clang must installed separately. Alternatively, [https://github.com/crazyjerz/geometria/releases release] may used installed via R CMD INSTALL geometria.*.tar.gz command.

title: Convex hull — C.chull
text: x Numeric vector values corresponding points’ X coordinate. y Numeric vector values corresponding points’ Y coordinate. algorithm String determining algorithm used compute convex hull. Available values : c("graham", "andrew", "quick"). mode String determining return values function. Available values : c("values", "indices")

title: Convex hull — C.chull
text: mode = "values", returns 2×length(x) matrix containing coordinates points forming convex hull. mode = "indices", returns indices points.
